summary: include_vars options ignore_unknown_extensions to skip non-vars files in a directory, and name to load vars into a single variable instead of top level.
questions: How do I load a vars file into one dictionary variable?
How do I avoid errors from README files in a vars directory?

answer_card.title: include_vars name and unknown extensions
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name`: put loaded vars under this variable instead of top level
- `ignore_unknown_extensions` (false): skip files like README in the directory
